summary: You can now drop a single queued change with one click, and false guard alarms are gone.

new.title: Remove an entry from the change queue
new.text: Every pending or failed entry in the change queue has a Remove from queue button. You give a reason; the entry is never applied and stays in the history.

fixes.title: No false removal budget alarm
fixes.text: Drift no longer raises the removal budget warning on the Guards panel for items the engine never removes on its own.

fixes.title: Fresh data right after each update
fixes.text: After an update, the engine refreshes its data and the drift check at its next run instead of hours later.

fixes.title: Record list no longer cut off
fixes.text: The list of record types now fits the window, so you can reach the last entries.
